event.name: December 2023 Free State severe thunderstorms and hail

criteria.description: Reports threshold_met = true with class_label = shelter_utility_threshold_met and no contradictory label.
criteria.name: Final threshold ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct boolean without the label, or 1 point for a threshold-met conclusion with incomplete JSON.

criteria.description: Extracts 1 fatality, 3 hospital admissions, 7 utility substations, and the four place-specific house counts.
criteria.name: Core report counts
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point per correctly extracted group; do not award credit for values invented outside the record.

criteria.name: Residential and public asset arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct derived value.

criteria.description: Uses 7 lightning-struck substations, applies the power-supply bonus, and counts four qualitative pathways.
criteria.name: Utility and qualitative pathway ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the substations, 1 point for applying or explaining the bonus, and 1 point for the four-pathway count.

criteria.description: Computes shelter_index = 567, utility_index = 125, shelter_utility_ratio = 4.536, and threshold_margin = 67.
criteria.name: Index and margin arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct computed value, allowing a ratio tolerance of 0.001.

criteria.description: Checks all three required inequalities: 567 >= 500, 342 >= 300, and 5 >= 5.
criteria.name: Three-part threshold test
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for checking only the shelter-utility inequality or for missing one of the two minimum-count tests.

criteria.description: Returns only the requested compact JSON and does not add exact hail size, wind gust, flood depth, outage duration, or agricultural area values.
criteria.name: Compact output discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct ledger with extra prose; award no credit for adding exact values outside the requested ledger.
